name: Senses
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Query actual observer/source positions, light, occlusion, range, hearing/noise, planes and borrowed senses. Own light emitters/fuel and magical darkness sources; perception and detection expose only eligible facts. Remote sensors retain their specific origin, control cost, movement, sense choice and limits.

blockers: Map reveal is not sight, detection, object discovery or knowledge. Existing senses and room noise hosts do not supply all remote-sensor/spell consumers; do not invent ambient light or weather from a dungeon description.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
